notes.title: Dennkind Dock Update 3.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[u]User Profiles[/u]
[list]
[*] A new feature for the Dock, to allow the creation of multiple environments. A Dock skin and extensions can be assigned to a user profile. Multiple user profile assignments for extensions is also supported.
[*] User profiles can be switched by clicking the middle area (the number) of the Actionbar's Index Switcher, which opens the User Profile Selector menu.
[/list]

[u]Overlay[/u]
[list]
[*] A new feature for the Dock, to allow bringing all extensions and the Actionbar into view, above all other windows. In addition the Overlay provides a menu for quick access to the "Computer", "Documents", "Downloads", and "OneDrive" Windows folders. The Overlay can be accessed by either assigning a new keyboard shortcut, using the Dock's Tray icon context menu or assigning the "Show / Hide Overlay" action to the Tray icon.
[/list]


[b]Extensions[/b]
[u]Desktop Panel[/u]
[list]
[*] A new extension for your Desktop, to manage files, folders and apps with a more clean and minimalistic design.
[/list]

[u]DriveInfo[/u]
[list]
[*] The drive's space indicator color changes if the available space falls under 10 percent
[/list]


[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The Actionbar index can now be changed via the mouse wheel
[*] Actionbar folders can now be given a name
[*] A mouse left click action can now be assigned to the Dock's Tray icon
[*] Added categories to the 'Select from Library' Selector
[*] Some minor design and layout improvements
[*] Multiple engine improvements.
[/list]


[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] Extension thumbnails reworked
[/list]


[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Steam Import feature would not work correctly for some users.
[*] Fixed an issue where empty Actionbar slots showed an incorrect tooltip.
[*] Fixed an issue with the reordering of Actionbar items
[/list]

notes.notes:
[b]Changelog:
BETA Build 2021.03.30.16.15[/b]

[list]
[*] ([i]Experimental[/i]) Wallpaper Engine Extension added
[/list]


[b]Additional Notes:[/b]
In order to try the new [b]Wallpaper Engine Extension[/b] you need to configure it first. Navigate to the Docks [b]Extensions[/b] tab and click the [b]Wallpaper Engine[/b] [b]Configure Extension[/b] button. Provide the path to the Wallpaper Engine executable and the Steam Workshop Content directory where all subscribed wallpapers are located.

[b]Wallpaper Engine Executable[/b]
...\\steamapps\\common\\wallpaper_engine\\wallpaper32.exe

[b]Workshop Content Directory[/b]
...\\steamapps\\workshop\\content

If both properties were setup up correctly, the [b]Wallpaper Engine Option[/b] should be now shown in the [b]User Profile Settings[/b].

notes.title: Dennkind Dock v.3 Beta Update (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
[b]Changelog:[/b]
[b]BETA Build 2021.03.09.12.00[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where adding files to the library could crash the application.
[/list]


[b]BETA Build 2021.03.08.13.25[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the import from Steam feature could not find games installed on the same directory as Steam.
[*] Added a filter to remove the 'Steamworks Common Redistributables' files from the import from Steam found games list.
[*] Added the option to show a games or applications Steam store page (if imported from Steam) to the library items context menu.
[*] Added the working directory for games and applications started from the Dock to prevent problems with their startup routines.
[*] Added a desired frame rate option (default 120) into the applications configuration.*1
[*] Library: Some minor layout und usability improvements. Library items are now started with a double click to prevent starting them by accident.
[*] Library: Changed the way how files are added to the Dock. The Dock now tries to retrieve the target file behind a shortcut to get rid of the annoying little arrow within the icon.*2
[*] Poster Extension: Poster images will now change automatically if a Steam imported game was assigned.
[/list]

[i]*1: The value can be changed, enabled or disabled in the applications configuration file 'Dennkind Dock.exe.config' located in the Dennkind Docks root directory.[/i]

[i]*2: This may cause issues with adding game shortcuts from other launchers like Epic or Gog. We are working on a solution and of course on a way to import games from other launchers too.[/i]

notes.title: Dennkind Dock v.3.0 - Beta Available
notes.notes:
[b]The new Dennkind Dock Update 3.0 is now available as beta. [/b]

Select the "beta - Beta Branch" option from the Dennkind Dock "Properties..." menu within Steam and let Steam update the Dock.

The Dennkind Dock v.3.0 Beta will replace your application files but not your Docks content. If you want to opt-out from the beta, just select the "default" branch from the Dennkind Dock "Properties..." menu (all your current Dock content will be restored).

The Dennkind Dock v.3.0 Beta contains all finished Extensions and Skins for testing. After the beta test all additional content will be available as DLC in the Dennkind Docks Steam store page.

We look forward to your feedback. Please write us your suggestions and criticisms about the beta via the Steam Forum.

notes.title: New Update available soon
notes.notes:
We have been busy and worked on numerous improvements and features for the Dennkind Dock. The new Update 3.0 will now be the most important update for the Dennkind Dock. With version 3.0 we have created a completely new foundation for future functions in the form of extensions and the possibility to offer new skins. 

This brings us one step closer to community skins. Once we have finished our work on Dennkind Dock Designer, the Dennkind Dock will also support self-created skins.

[b]The most important changes and features of the update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Support for skins implemented
[*] Support for extensions implemented
[*] The dock can now be freely moved and aligned on the Desktop
[*] The library item and folder icons can now be changed
[*] Optional parameters can be passed to library items
[/list]

The new update will be available soon. Currently we are still working on the translation, continue to improve small things and test a lot.

notes.title: Dennkind Dock Update 2.0
notes.notes:
[b]New Features:[/b]

[b]Desktop Containers[/b]
Organize your games and apps in the new Desktop Containers. Adjust the size and position to your liking. Create as many Desktop Containers as you want. Use the handy new keyboard shortcut to show or hide the Desktop Containers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37961850/fcf29f7904a67850b1c765c001ac31c4547c101f.gif[/img]

[b]More Actionbar Slots[/b]
Switch between the new Actionbar slots for more favorite items.

[b]Library Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] New view added: Show labeled library items.
[*] New view added: Show library items as list.
[*] Search improved.
[*] Rename library items.
[*] Categorize library items.
[*] New settings option added: Show or hide Desktop Containers.
[/list]

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
We are already working on the next major update. Update 3.0 for the Dennkind Dock will include the Steam Workshop integration. Allowing our community to create and share own skins. More details will follow.

notes.title: Dennkind Dock Release
notes.notes:
We are very excited about our first app release here on Steam. We really hope you like the Dennkind Dock. Once again, we like to thank our BETA testers for their time and valuable feedback. Without you it would be not possible to reach the degree of quality we are aiming for.

With the release of the Dennkind Dock, we set the foundation for many improvements and features. To make the Dennkind Dock constantly better, we like to include our community. 

Please give us your feedback at any time. Things you like or not, as well as your wishes for future updates. Several new features are already in the works that we will make available to you soon.

[b]Here is a look at the future of the Dennkind Dock:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Community Skins: [/b]
We are currently working on a tool, to make it easy for you to create your own skins.

[*] [b]Steam Workshop Integration: [/b]
To give you an easy way to share and get community skins.

[*] [b]Dennkind Dock Extensions: [/b]
We want you to be able to extend the Dennkind Docks functionality.
[/list]

[b]Feedback and Support[/b]
Reach out to us if you have feedback or need support: support@dennkind.com
